name: basic.json
description: Basic rule set for auditing AWS environments

rules.name: IAM User MFA Token
rules.description: IAM Users should have MFA enabled

rules.name: IAM User Access Keys
rules.description: Access Keys should not be used for IAM Users. Instead use IAM Identity Center to setup Single Sign-on.

rules.name: IAM User Inline Policies
rules.description: IAM Users should not have inline IAM policies. Instead use IAM Groups to define IAM Policies and assign the user to the group.

rules.name: IAM User Attached Policies
rules.description: IAM Policies should not be attached to IAM Users. Instead use IAM Groups to define IAM Policies and assign the user to the group.

rules.name: S3 Public Access Block
rules.description: S3 Buckets should not be publicly available
rules.condition: $data === false || !isset($data['PublicAccessBlockConfiguration']) || ($data['PublicAccessBlockConfiguration']['BlockPublicAcls'] ?? false) == false || ($data['PublicAccessBlockConfiguration']['BlockPublicPolicy'] ?? false) == false || ($data['PublicAccessBlockConfiguration']['IgnorePublicAcls'] ?? false) == false || ($data['PublicAccessBlockConfiguration']['RestrictPublicBuckets'] ?? false) == false

rules.name: S3 Bucket Encryption
rules.description: S3 Buckets should have encryption enabled

rules.name: S3 Bucket versioning
rules.description: S3 Buckets should have versioning enabled

rules.name: EC2 Public IP Address
rules.description: EC2 Instances should not have a Public IP Address

rules.name: Subnet Default Public IP
rules.description: EC2 Subnets should not have Public IP enabled by default
